standards.summary: Verify experimentally properties of dilations from a center.
Use similarity transformations to determine whether figures are similar and explain correspondence.
Use properties of similarity transformations to establish AA similarity.
Use similarity reasoning in proofs involving triangles and proportional relationships.
Use congruence and similarity criteria to solve problems and prove relationships.
Use geometric shapes and scale relationships to model objects and solve design or measurement problems.

evidence: identify preserved angle measures and scaled lengths

evidence_policy.automatic: Selected-response mastery items may be scored locally by the assessment engine.
evidence_policy.human_review: Written proofs, transformation explanations, scale-model design, field-study reasoning, corrections, and project evidence may require teacher, mentor, or qualified reviewer judgment.
evidence_policy.mastery: A numeric score is one evidence source; documented corrections and human-reviewed performance evidence remain part of mastery determination.
